paite: Solomon paunakte. Tapa pil in pa kipak abawl a; himahleh tapa hai anu gikna ahi.
heading: Solomon Paunakte

paite: Gitlouhna sumte'n bangmah aloh tak kei; himahleh diktatna in sihna a kipan atankhia hi.
TOUPA'N midiktat kialsih aphal kei ding; himahleh migilou a kipan atankhia hi.
Khut ze-ol mi ahong genthei a; himahleh mithanuam khut in hauhsakna abawl hi.
Nipi lai a lakhawmpa tapa pil ahi; himahleh pawltak hun a ihmu zumhuai omsak tapa ahi.
Midiktat lutung ah vualzawlnate a-om a; himahleh gilou kam hiamgamna in atuam hi.
Midik theihgigena anuam a; himahleh migilou min amuat mang ding.
Lungtang pil in thupiakte asang ding a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
Tangtak a pai hoihtak in apai a; himahleh alampite kilawmlousak theih in a-om ding hi.
Amit a chiamtehna bawl in lungkhamna a-omsak a; himahleh mihai haiham apuk ding.
Midiktat kam hinna tuikhuk ahi; himahleh hiamgamna in gilou kam atuam hi.
Huatna in kidouna atokthou a, himahleh itna in tatlekna tengteng akhuh hi.
Theihkak theihna neimi muk ah pilna muh in a-om; himahleh chiang theihsiamna neiloumi nungzang a ding ahi.
Mipilte'n theihna akholkhawm ua; himahleh mihai kam in siatna anaih.
Mihausa hauhsakna akhopi muanhuai ahi; migenthei siatna agentheih uh ahi.
Midiktat sepgimna in hinna azuan a; gilou punna in khelhna lam.
Bawlhoihna limsak hinna lampi ah a-om a; himahleh salhna don lou apaikhial hi.
Huatna sel zuauthei mukte a kipan ahi a; huan migensiatna gen mihai ahi.
Thu tampite ah tatlekna a-om lou kei a; himahleh amukte thuzoh in piltak in ahih hi.
Midiktat lei dangka hoihpen bang ahi; migilou lungtang athamatna neuchik ahi.
Midiktat mukte'n mi tampi avak a; himahleh mihaite theihsiamna taksap ziak in asi uh.
TOUPA vualzawlna in hauhsakna abawl a, huan huai ah lungkhamna abehlap kei hi.
Mihai a ding in gitlouhna hih kisukhalhna bang ahi; huchibang in theisiammi a ding in pilna ahi.
Migilou launa, amah tung ah ahong tung ding; midiktat deihna phal in a-om ding hi.
Pingpei alenmang bang in, migilou a-om nawn kei; himahleh midiktat tangtawn suangphum ahi.
Zu thuk in ha asuksiat bang in meikhu in mit asusia a, huchibang mah in amah sawlte a ding in mi zongzaw a-om hi.
TOUPA kihtak in nite asausak a, himahleh migilou kumte hihtom ahi ding.
Midiktat lametna kipahna ahi ding, himahleh migilou lametna amangthang ding.
TOUPA lampi a mitangte a ding in kulh muanhuai ahi; himahleh migilou nasem mite a ding in siatna ahi.
Midiktat suankhiak ahi ngei kei ding; himahleh gamsung ah migilou ateng kei ding hi.
Midiktat kam in pilna ahon tun a; himahleh lei gina lou satkhiak in a-om ding.
Midiktat mukte'n lak tuak bang ahia athei a, himahleh migilou kam in ginatlouhna agen hi.
